name: sticker
title: Sticker
description: A die-cut sticker you can peel off and stick somewhere else. Drag from any edge and the flap folds back over itself with its pale backing, crease shading and a shadow underneath. Let go early and it falls flat; peel past a threshold and it comes off in your hand, tilting as you carry it, and slaps down where you drop it. The border is traced from the artwork's real shape, the nearest corner curls up on hover, and the keyboard can lift and move it.
